problem.internal.title: Internal error
problem.internal.detail: An unexpected error occurred. Give the request id to support.
problem.not-found.title: Resource not found
problem.not-found.detail: The requested resource does not exist or you have no access to it.
problem.method-not-allowed.title: Method not allowed
problem.method-not-allowed.detail: The {method} method is not accepted on this resource.
problem.service-unavailable.title: Service unavailable
problem.service-unavailable.detail: A required dependency did not answer. Try again in a moment.
problem.validation.title: Invalid data
problem.validation.detail: One or more fields failed validation. See the list of errors.
problem.not-authenticated.title: Sign-in required
problem.not-authenticated.detail: Sign in to the platform to continue.
problem.session-expired.title: Session expired
problem.session-expired.detail: Your session has ended. Sign in again to continue.
problem.forbidden.title: Access denied
problem.forbidden.detail: Your role does not allow this action.
problem.state-conflict.title: Action unavailable in the current state
problem.state-conflict.detail: The action does not exist in the current state of the resource.
problem.duplicate-name.title: Name already used
problem.duplicate-name.detail: A project with this name already exists in the organization.
problem.incomplete-configuration.title: Incomplete configuration
problem.incomplete-configuration.detail: Some items must be configured before starting the workflow. See the list of what is missing.
problem.model-without-capability.title: Model without the required capability
problem.model-without-capability.detail: The chosen model lacks the {missing_capacity} capability required by the stage.
problem.model-without-current-price.deta: The model has no current price in the price table.
problem.approval-mode-not-allowed.title: Approval mode not allowed
problem.approval-mode-not-allowed.detail: This gate only accepts human approval.
problem.budget-above-ceiling.title: Limit above the ceiling
problem.budget-above-ceiling.detail: The stop limit exceeds the organization ceiling.
problem.effective-period-in-use.title: Effective period in use
problem.effective-period-in-use.detail: This effective period is already in force or was used. Record a new effective period.
problem.invalid-key.title: Key refused by the provider
problem.idempotency-conflict.title: Idempotency key reused
problem.idempotency-conflict.detail: The Idempotency-Key was already used with a different body.
problem.failed-precondition.title: Outdated version
problem.failed-precondition.detail: The resource changed since it was read. Reload and try again.
problem.required-precondition.title: Required header missing
problem.required-precondition.detail: The If-Match or Idempotency-Key header is missing.
field.range: Value out of the allowed range.
field.length: Length out of the allowed range.
field.decimal: Must be a non-negative decimal as text.
field.currency: Currency differs from the organization currency.
field.past: The date cannot be in the past.
problem.invalid-csrf.title: Invalid anti-CSRF token
problem.invalid-csrf.detail: The decision needs the anti-CSRF token of the session.
problem.reauthentication-required.title: Reauthentication required
problem.reauthentication-required.detail: Sign in again to confirm this critical decision.
problem.pending-human-check.title: Human check pending
problem.pending-human-check.detail: Confirm every human check of the gate.
problem.artifact-invalid.title: Artifact out of schema
problem.artifact-invalid.detail: The artifact failed the schema validation of its type.
problem.revoked-session.title: Session revoked
problem.revoked-session.detail: The session was ended in the SSO. Sign in again.
problem.requires-web-session.title: Action only on the web
problem.requires-web-session.detail: The desktop app only reads and notifies. Open this screen on the web to act.
problem.account-without-access.title: Account without access
problem.account-without-access.detail: Your account has no access to the platform. Talk to the organization administrator.
problem.last-approver.title: The project needs at least one approver
problem.last-approver.detail: Give the approver role to someone else before removing this one.
problem.lead-required.title: The project needs a lead
problem.lead-required.detail: Only the organization administrator transfers the lead role.
problem.separation-of-duties.title: Role assigned less than 24 hours ago
problem.separation-of-duties.detail: Whoever assigned the approver role to themselves waits 24 hours before approving a gate of the project; the administrator does not assign roles to themselves.
pending.gate.title: Gate {gate} (round {round}) awaiting decision
pending.question.title: Questions of the {agent} agent in wave {wave}
pending.finding_escalated.title: Finding {finding} escalated after {cycles} cycles: approver decision
problem.tool-not-allowed.title: Tool outside the agent role
problem.tool-not-allowed.detail: The tool {tool} is not allowed for the role of the agent (permissoes.yaml).
problem.blocked-skill.title: Skill version not available
problem.blocked-skill.detail: The skill version {skill} is not unblocked and cannot be associated.
problem.constraint-violated.title: Invalid data
problem.constraint-violated.detail: The request breaks a rule of the data. Review the values sent.
problem.confirmation-required.title: Confirmation required
problem.confirmation-required.detail: Confirm the action: it cannot be undone or it is charged.
problem.project-not-ended.title: Cancel the project before deleting it
problem.project-not-ended.detail: Only a completed or canceled project can be deleted. Cancel the project before deleting it.
problem.budget-exhausted.title: Budget exhausted
problem.budget-exhausted.detail: The spend reached the stop limit. Raise the stop limit above the spend before resuming.
problem.blocking-finding.title: Approval blocked by a finding
problem.blocking-finding.detail: A critical or high finding is open without risk acceptance, or its acceptance expired. See the list of findings.
pending.budget.title: Budget of the project reached {percentage}% of the stop limit
